questions.stem: Given sets A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {2, 3, 4}, what is the intersection of sets A and B?
questions.solution: The intersection of sets A and B contains elements that are common to both sets. In this case, the intersection is {2, 3} because these elements appear in both A and B.
questions.explanation: Intersection of sets: The set containing all elements that are both in set A and set B.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A or B, which represent the original sets without considering their intersection.

questions.stem: What is the union of sets C = {3, 5, 7} and D = {5, 6, 7}? Write your answer in roster form.
questions.solution: The union of sets C and D contains all elements from both sets, without repetition. In roster form, it is {3, 5, 6, 7}.
questions.explanation: Union of sets: The set containing all elements that are in either set A or set B (or both), without duplicates.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Including elements not in either set (like 4) or repeating elements from one set.

questions.stem: Given the universal set U = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} and set E = {2, 4}, what is the complement of set E? Write your answer in roster form.
questions.solution: The complement of set E contains all elements in the universal set U that are not in set E. In roster form, it is {1, 3, 5}.
questions.explanation: Complement of a set: The set containing all elements in the universal set that are not in the given set.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Including elements from set E or missing elements from U.

questions.stem: Set F = {x | x is an even number less than 10} and G = {x | x is a prime number less than 10}. What is the intersection of sets F and G?
questions.solution: The intersection of sets F and G contains the even prime number less than 10, which is 2.
questions.explanation: Intersection of sets: The set containing all elements that are both in set A and set B.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Including non-prime even numbers or forgetting that 2 is the only even prime.

questions.stem: Set H = {x | x is a multiple of 3 less than 15} and I = {x | x is an odd number less than 15}. What is the union of sets H and I?
questions.solution: The union of sets H and I contains all multiples of 3 less than 15 (3, 6, 9, 12) and odd numbers less than 15 (5, 7, 9, 11, 13).
questions.explanation: Union of sets: The set containing all elements that are in either set A or set B (or both), without duplicates.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Including numbers not in either set or repeating elements from one set.

questions.stem: Set J = {x | x is a perfect square less than 10} and K = {x | x is an integer between -5 and 5}. What is the complement of set J with respect to set K?
questions.solution: The complement of set J with respect to set K contains all elements in set K that are not perfect squares less than 10. In roster form, it is {-5, -4, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 6, 7, 8, 9}.
questions.explanation: Complement of a set: The set containing all elements in the universal set that are not in the given set.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Including perfect squares or missing numbers from the range -5 to 5.

questions.stem: Set L = {x | x is a positive integer less than 10} and M = {x | x is an even positive integer less than 10}. What is the difference between set L and set M?
questions.solution: The difference between set L and set M contains all positive integers less than 10 that are not even. In roster form, it is {1, 3, 5, 7, 9}.
questions.explanation: Difference of sets: The set containing elements that are in the first set but not in the second set.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Including even numbers or missing odd numbers from set L.
